project_meta.title: Octopus vs Squid: Who Is Stranger?

global_style.art_style: High-quality entertaining whiteboard comparison animation. Bright clean white background with subtle paper texture. Realistic photographic animal cutouts with accurate anatomy, combined with a highly expressive hand-drawn black stickman presenter. The presenter must be physically active and animated in every scene, with expressive poses, walking, jumping, leaning, reacting, pointing, and interacting with the subjects. Use a consistent left-right layout: octopus on the left and squid on the right. Use colorful arrows, circles, labels, and simple visual demonstrations. Dynamic visual storytelling, playful humor, frequent visual changes, clean professional composition.
global_style.negative_prompt: Static presenter, motionless stickman, incorrect pointing direction, presenter pointing at the wrong animal, incorrect animal anatomy, extra limbs, missing tentacles, cartoon animal redesign, distorted animal photographs, cluttered whiteboard, excessive text, tiny unreadable labels, dark background, inconsistent character appearance, random decorative objects, multiple actions in one image, watermarks.

whiteboard.label: Comparison Whiteboard
whiteboard.visual_dna: A bright white educational entertainment studio with a clean whiteboard background, subtle paper texture, generous empty space, two clear comparison zones, left zone for octopus and right zone for squid, and a small central space where the presenter can move freely.

stickman.label: Expressive Stickman Presenter
stickman.visual_dna: A distinctive hand-drawn black stickman with a large round white head, bold black outlines, expressive eyes, movable eyebrows, a flexible mouth, thin but clearly articulated arms and legs, and consistent proportions. Extremely expressive and energetic personality. Capable of walking, running, jumping, dancing, leaning, scratching his head, reacting with shock, pretending to swim, imitating animals, and interacting with objects. Keep the exact same character design in every scene.

octopus.label: Octopus
octopus.visual_dna: A realistic common octopus photographed underwater, rounded soft mantle, eight distinct flexible arms with visible suckers along their undersides, natural reddish-brown coloration, realistic marine anatomy, isolated against a clean background.

squid.label: Squid
squid.visual_dna: A realistic squid photographed underwater, elongated streamlined mantle, eight shorter arms and two noticeably longer feeding tentacles, visible fins near the mantle, realistic marine anatomy, natural coloration, isolated against a clean background.

octopus_arms.label: Octopus Arms
octopus_arms.visual_dna: A scientifically accurate close-up of eight octopus arms spreading outward, with visible rows of circular suckers along the undersides.

squid_tentacles.label: Squid Tentacles
squid_tentacles.visual_dna: A scientifically accurate close-up of a squid showing eight shorter arms and two longer feeding tentacles ending in specialized clubs.

octopus_camouflage.label: Octopus Camouflage
octopus_camouflage.visual_dna: A realistic octopus changing its skin coloration and texture to blend into a rocky underwater environment.

squid_school.label: Squid Group
squid_school.visual_dna: A group of realistic squid swimming together in an open ocean environment, maintaining coordinated movement.

octopus_ink.label: Octopus Ink Cloud
octopus_ink.visual_dna: A realistic octopus releasing a dark ink cloud underwater as a defensive distraction.

squid_ink.label: Squid Ink Cloud
squid_ink.visual_dna: A realistic squid releasing a dark ink cloud underwater as a defensive distraction.

comparison_labels.label: Comparison Labels
comparison_labels.visual_dna: Clean bold black typography on small whiteboard labels with subtle colored highlights, short readable phrases, arrows, and circles.

beats.narration_text: समुद्र में दो ऐसे जीव रहते हैं जिन्हें देखकर लगता है जैसे किसी एलियन की दुनिया से आए हों!
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.octopus} on the left and {assets.squid} on the right as large realistic photographic subjects. The stickman runs into the center of the whiteboard, suddenly stops, and stares at both creatures with wide eyes and an open mouth. Both arms are raised in surprise.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the octopus-left and squid-right layout. Introduce the energetic stickman in the center in a surprised arrival pose.

beats.narration_text: एक के आठ हाथ हैं, दूसरे के भी आठ हाथ हैं... लेकिन रुकिए! इन दोनों में फर्क बहुत मजेदार है।
beats.prompt_action: The stickman walks toward the octopus on the LEFT, points specifically at its eight arms, then turns his head toward the squid on the RIGHT with a confused expression. Add a large question mark between the two animals.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep both animals fixed in their respective positions. Move the stickman toward the left animal and make his pointing direction unmistakably toward the octopus.

beats.narration_text: पहले पहचान लेते हैं। बाईं तरफ है ऑक्टोपस और दाईं तरफ है स्क्विड।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.octopus} on the LEFT with a clear label OCTOPUS directly underneath. Show {assets.squid} on the RIGHT with a clear label SQUID directly underneath. The stickman stands between them and points with his left hand toward the octopus and his right hand toward the squid.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep both animal positions fixed. Add accurate labels. The presenter's two hands must point toward their corresponding animals.

beats.narration_text: दोनों समुद्र में रहते हैं, दोनों के शरीर मुलायम होते हैं, और दोनों अपने दुश्मनों से बचने के लिए कमाल की तरकीबें जानते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: The stickman pretends to swim by moving both arms and legs in a playful swimming pose between the two animals. Add small blue water waves underneath both animal photographs.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Retain both animal photographs and labels. Change the stickman into a playful swimming pose and add subtle water wave illustrations.

beats.narration_text: सबसे पहले इनके हाथों का अंतर देखो। ऑक्टोपस के पूरे आठ हाथ होते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Enlarge {assets.octopus_arms} on the LEFT side. Show all eight arms clearly separated with visible suckers. The stickman walks to the left, bends forward, and counts the arms with an exaggerated pointing gesture.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on the octopus on the left. Keep the squid on the right smaller in the background. The stickman must point only toward the octopus arms.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन स्क्विड के आठ छोटे हाथों के अलावा दो लंबे टेंटेकल्स भी होते हैं। यानी कुल दस उपांग!
beats.prompt_action: Enlarge {assets.squid_tentacles} on the RIGHT side. Clearly distinguish eight shorter arms from two long feeding tentacles. The stickman quickly runs from the left toward the right and stretches both of his arms forward to imitate the two long tentacles. Add labels reading 8 ARMS and 2 TENTACLES.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Shift visual focus to the squid on the right. Preserve the accurate distinction between eight arms and two longer tentacles. The stickman must now point and gesture toward the squid.

beats.narration_text: और जानते हो ऑक्टोपस की सबसे अजीब बात? उसके हाथों पर सक्शन कप होते हैं, जिनसे वो चीजों को पकड़ सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show a close-up of the suckers on {assets.octopus_arms} on the LEFT. The stickman stands beside the close-up and pretends to stick his hand onto the whiteboard, looking amazed. Add a circular magnification around the suckers.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the close-up specifically focused on octopus suckers. The stickman demonstrates sticking and gripping only on the octopus side.

beats.narration_text: वो अपनी आठों भुजाओं से चीजों को छू सकता है, पकड़ सकता है और घूम सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.octopus} holding a small shell with one arm while its other arms explore the nearby rocks. The stickman imitates the octopus by extending both arms in different directions and looking hilariously overwhelmed.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Remain on the octopus side. Add a shell and rock interaction. Change the stickman's pose to an exaggerated imitation of multiple moving arms.

beats.narration_text: अब स्क्विड को देखो। इसका शरीर ज्यादा लंबा और तेज तैरने के हिसाब से बना होता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.squid} prominently on the RIGHT with its streamlined elongated body and visible fins. The stickman runs across the whiteboard from the center to the right, leaning forward like a racing athlete and pointing toward the squid's body.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Shift attention to the squid on the right. Keep its elongated body and fins clearly visible. The presenter must face and point toward the squid.

beats.narration_text: इसके शरीर के पीछे छोटे फिन्स होते हैं, जो तैरते समय इसे दिशा बदलने में मदद करते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show a close-up of the fins near the mantle of {assets.squid}. Add two curved arrows showing water movement around the fins. The stickman bends down and points directly at the squid's fins.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the squid as the only enlarged subject. The presenter points specifically at the fins near the squid's body, not toward the octopus.

beats.narration_text: अब आते हैं इनके छिपने के हुनर पर। ऑक्टोपस रंग और त्वचा की बनावट बदलकर अपने आसपास में गायब जैसा हो सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.octopus_camouflage} on the LEFT, with the octopus blending into rocky underwater surroundings. The stickman walks toward the left, covers his eyes with both hands, then peeks between his fingers while trying to find the camouflaged octopus.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on the octopus camouflage demonstration. Keep the stickman searching on the left side, clearly interacting with the camouflaged animal.

beats.narration_text: स्क्विड भी रंग बदल सकता है, लेकिन कई स्क्विड अपने बड़े समूह में तैरने के लिए भी जाने जाते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.squid_school} on the RIGHT with multiple squid swimming together. The stickman runs toward the right and tries to swim alongside the group, copying their direction with a funny synchronized swimming pose.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Shift attention from the octopus to the squid group on the right. The stickman must move to the right and imitate the squid swimming together.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन खतरा आते ही दोनों के पास एक जबरदस्त ट्रिक होती है। दोनों स्याही छोड़कर दुश्मन को चकमा दे सकते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Show {assets.octopus_ink} on the LEFT and {assets.squid_ink} on the RIGHT, each releasing a separate dark ink cloud underwater. The stickman jumps backward in the center with a shocked expression and both hands raised.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show both animals performing the same defensive technique. Keep the two ink clouds separate and the stickman in the center reacting to both.

beats.narration_text: और ये स्याही सिर्फ धुआं बनाने के लिए नहीं होती, ये शिकारी का ध्यान भटकाने में मदद करती है ताकि ये भाग सकें।
beats.prompt_action: Show the ink clouds spreading through the water. Both animals move away from their respective clouds. The stickman crouches behind a small illustrated ink cloud and then peeks out with a mischievous expression.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Retain the two ink clouds. Show both animals escaping away from the clouds and the stickman playfully demonstrating the distraction technique.

beats.narration_text: तो अब बताओ, कौन ज्यादा अजीब है? आठ हाथों वाला ऑक्टोपस या दस उपांगों वाला स्क्विड?
beats.prompt_action: Bring {assets.octopus} back to the LEFT and {assets.squid} back to the RIGHT at equal size. The stickman runs into the center, looks left, looks right, scratches his head, and raises both hands as if unable to decide. Add two large question marks above the animals.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Restore the original balanced comparison layout. The stickman stands in the middle, visibly undecided and looking between both animals.

beats.narration_text: मेरे हिसाब से दोनों ही समुद्र के सबसे मजेदार जीवों में से हैं। लेकिन तुम्हें कौन ज्यादा पसंद आया?
beats.prompt_action: The stickman walks toward the viewer, points directly outward with one hand, and gestures toward both animals with the other. Give the stickman a friendly smiling expression. Add a small speech bubble with two empty voting choices below the animals.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep both animals visible. Move the presenter toward the foreground and make him directly engage the audience.

beats.narration_text: कमेंट में बताओ, और अगली बार किन दो अजीब चीजों का मुकाबला करवाना चाहते हो?
beats.prompt_action: The stickman excitedly points downward toward the comment area, then raises one hand as if inviting suggestions. Keep the octopus and squid smaller in the background. Add a clean readable label reading YOUR NEXT COMPARISON?
beats.session_delta_prompt: Finish with the presenter actively inviting audience participation. Preserve the same whiteboard identity and leave clear space for the comment prompt.
